mcp.name: ArcFlare machine server
mcp.description: Everything: run and supervise commands, build and test with a verdict, open apps, desktop control, the web, the browser, Blender, 3D and speech.

mcp.name: ArcFlare desktop control
mcp.description: See the screen and use the mouse and keyboard: screenshot, mouse, type, key, windows, focus, clipboard. Windows, Linux (X11) and macOS.

mcp.name: ArcFlare web
mcp.description: Search the web and read a page as text. No browser needed; public internet only.

mcp.name: ArcFlare browser
mcp.description: A real browser with no window: pages built by JavaScript, clicks and forms. Uses the Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave already on the computer.

mcp.name: Filesystem
mcp.description: Read, write and search files inside the folders you name. The reference server from the MCP project.

argument.name: folder
argument.about: the folder it may use (repeat for more)

mcp.name: Memory
mcp.description: A small knowledge graph the model can write to and read back in later sessions. The reference server from the MCP project.

mcp.name: Sequential thinking
mcp.description: A scratchpad for working a problem through in numbered, revisable steps. The reference server from the MCP project.

mcp.name: Git
mcp.description: Read and search a Git repository: status, diff, log, blame, and commits. The reference server from the MCP project.

mcp.name: Time
mcp.description: The current time, and conversion between time zones. The reference server from the MCP project.

mcp.name: Playwright
mcp.description: Microsoft's browser automation server: a fuller alternative to ArcFlare's browser, with its own downloaded browsers.

mcp.name: Context7
mcp.description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries, fetched from Context7's service.

mcp.name: Blender MCP
mcp.description: Model, sculpt and render in a running Blender. Needs Blender open with the blender-mcp addon; ArcFlare's machine server can start it (blender_launch).
